value: After the real-game day, training plays at Ascension 20 by default (owner, 2026-11-14). New datasets record their level; A0 and A20 data are never pooled silently. Goal 2's ruler moves to A20 once A20 controls exist; A0 results stay valid at A0. First come the ascension key through learn/selfplay/finetune, the level in the registry, the choosers' 75 max HP, then 80 (a)'s A20 controls.

sources.anchor: Ascension 20 becomes the default setting after the real-game day (owner, 2026-11-14)
